name: research-task
description: Spike task: fetch a page through the vault, write notes/x.md, run one git command in the container, prove each tier sees the other's last write and that the canary never reaches the sandbox, then hand back.

seed.README.md:
# Research workspace

Seeded by the M0 spike scenario.
seed.brief.txt: Find the title of https://example.com and note it in notes/x.md.

args.command: mkdir -p research && curl -sS https://example.com/ -o research/example.html && grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>' research/example.html

args.content:
# Notes

- example.com title: Example Domain (fetched through the vault)

args.command: git init -q && cat notes/x.md && grep -c 'Example Domain' research/example.html && git add -A && git -c user.name=harbour -c user.email=harbour@example.invalid commit -qm 'research notes' && git log --oneline | tee git-log.txt && env | grep -ci canary || true
git --version > /dev/null && curl -sS https://postman-echo.com/headers | jq -r '.headers["x-harbour-vault"]' && curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' https://api.github.com/zen

finalAnswer: Done: the title of example.com is "Example Domain"; notes are in notes/x.md and committed in the container's git repository.
